classification_rules.exact_primary_token_parity: Every primary raw and Harmony delta and both raw and Harmony interaction-token differentials are zero, with all structural audits passed.
classification_rules.nonzero_primary_token_difference: The structural audit completed and at least one primary or interaction raw or Harmony token delta is nonzero.
classification_rules.runtime_failure: An immutable-input, dependency, prompt-population, audit, rendering, or measurement failure prevented completion.

primary_estimand_warning: Main effects of explicit versus metadata conditions are not independently interpretable as pure epistemic effects. Future scientific inference must be based primarily on preregistered case-by-condition interactions.
interpretation_constraint: This tokenizer-only measurement does not test H1a, H1b, H2, Theory of Mind, coordination, autonomous planning, or model cognition.
